reasons: Both give the correct verified expression 6 ÷ (1 − 3/4) = 24 and a sound work-backwards explanation of why integer paths fail and why division by a fraction helps. A makes the idea slightly more concrete for a fifth grader (pizza slices, the sequence 6÷1/2, 6÷1/3, 6÷1/4) and supplies the answer to the 1,5,5,5 follow-up so the parent can check it, whereas B leaves the parent without that answer. B's explicit 6 ÷ 24 = 1/4 step and honest hedging on uniqueness are good, but the differences are minor.
